description_en: Configures monitoring and alerting to monitor the latency and exception status of a change tracking channel
description_zh: 配置监控报警，来监控订阅通道的延迟和异常状态
kebab_example: aliyun dts configure-subscription-instance-alert --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --subscription-instance-id dtsl8zl9ek62920000 --api-version 2020-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ConfigureSubscriptionInstanceAlert

parameters.help_en: The ID of the region where the change tracking instance resides. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141033.html
parameters.help_zh: 数据订阅实例所在地域的ID，详情请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141033.html
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the change tracking instance. You can call the DescribeSubscriptionInstances operation to query the instance ID
parameters.help_zh: 数据订阅实例ID，可以通过调用DescribeSubscriptionInstances接口查询
parameters.name: subscription_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to monitor the latency status. Valid values:

enable: yes.
disable: no.

Default value: enable.
You must specify at least one of this parameter and the ErrorAlertStatus parameter
parameters.help_zh:
是否监控延迟状态，取值：

enable：是。
disable：否。

默认取值为enable。
本参数和ErrorAlertStatus参数两者中至少传入一个
parameters.name: delay_alert_status

parameters.help_en:
The mobile phone numbers of contacts for latency alerts. Separate multiple mobile phone numbers with commas (,).
This parameter is supported only on the China site (aliyun.com). Only Chinese mainland mobile phone numbers are supported, and you can specify up to 10 mobile phone numbers.
China site (Chinese mainland) does not support Chinese mainland mobile phone alerts. You can only https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/175876.html
parameters.help_zh:
延迟报警的联系人手机号码，多个手机号码以英文逗号（,）分隔。
本参数目前只支持中国站，仅支持大陆手机号码，且最多传入10个手机号码。
国际站不支持手机告警，仅支持https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/175876.html
parameters.name: delay_alert_phone

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to monitor the exception status. Valid values:

enable: yes.
disable: no.

Default value: enable.
You must specify at least one of this parameter and the DelayAlertStatus parameter.
After you enable exception status monitoring, an alert is triggered when an exception is detected
parameters.help_zh:
是否监控异常状态，取值：

enable：是。
disable：否。

默认取值为enable。
本参数和DelayAlertStatus参数两者中至少传入一个。
开启监控异常状态功能后，如果检测到异常，将触发报警
parameters.name: error_alert_status

parameters.help_en:
The mobile phone numbers of contacts for exception alerts. Separate multiple mobile phone numbers with commas (,).
This parameter is supported only on the China site (aliyun.com). Only Chinese mainland mobile phone numbers are supported, and you can specify up to 10 mobile phone numbers.
China site (Chinese mainland) does not support Chinese mainland mobile phone alerts. You can only https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/175876.html
parameters.help_zh:
异常报警的联系人手机号码，多个手机号码以英文逗号（,）分隔。
本参数目前只支持中国站，仅支持大陆手机号码，且最多传入10个手机号码。
国际站不支持手机告警，仅支持https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/175876.html
parameters.name: error_alert_phone

parameters.help_en:
The threshold for triggering a latency alert. Unit: seconds. The value must be an integer. Set the threshold based on your business requirements. To avoid alert fluctuations caused by network issues or database loads, set the threshold to 10 seconds or more.
This parameter is required when DelayAlertStatus is set to enable
parameters.help_zh:
触发延迟报警的阈值，单位为秒且需为整数，可根据业务需要设置阈值，建议设置10秒以上，避免因网络、数据库负载等原因导致的延迟波动。
当DelayAlertStatus取值为enable时，本参数必须传入
parameters.name: delay_over_seconds

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account. You do not need to specify this parameter because it will be deprecated
parameters.help_zh: 阿里云主账号ID，无需设置，该参数即将下线
parameters.name: account_id
